title: hortensia serrata var. angustata
intro: Hortensia serrata var. angustata, commonly known as a type of hawthorn, is a plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family and is traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to support cardiovascular health by reducing blood pressure and improving circulation, as well as its potential to help manage symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Hortensia serrata var. angustata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which contribute to its cardiovascular benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which have been shown to have cardiovascular-protective effects.
